title: Lexington, KY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lexington, KY: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lexington is a city in KY with a population of 322,570. Horse Capital of the World with bluegrass, bourbon, and affordable Southern charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
